name: inheritance6.k
model:
class Person {
  father:Person
  child:Person

  req father.child = this
}

p1:Person

p2:Person

req p1 != p2

req p2.father = p1

req p1.child = p2

req p1.father = p2

req p2.child = p1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (p1 Ref)(p2 Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Person (mk-Person (father Ref)(child Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Person (sel-Person Person))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Person ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Person (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Person ((this Ref)) Person
  (sel-Person (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Person ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Person this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.p1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!p1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (p1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.p2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!p2 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (p2 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Person:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Person.father: ---

(define-fun Person.father ((this Ref)) Ref
  (father (deref-Person this))
)

(define-fun Person!father ((this Ref)) Ref
  (father (deref-Person this))
)

; --- getters for Person.child: ---

(define-fun Person.child ((this Ref)) Ref
  (child (deref-Person this))
)

(define-fun Person!child ((this Ref)) Ref
  (child (deref-Person this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Person (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Person (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Person.father (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Person.child (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Person.father (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Person.child (TopLevelDeclarations!p2 this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!p1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Person:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Person Person)
(declare-const const-2-Person Person)
(declare-const const-3-Person Person)
(declare-const const-4-Person Person)
(declare-const const-5-Person Person)
(declare-const const-6-Person Person)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Person.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Person (Person!father this))
)

(assert (! (Person.inv1 1) :named _xkassert7))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 2) :named _xkassert8))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 3) :named _xkassert9))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 4) :named _xkassert10))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 5) :named _xkassert11))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 6) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Person.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Person (Person!child this))
)

(assert (! (Person.inv2 1) :named _xkassert13))
(assert (! (Person.inv2 2) :named _xkassert14))
(assert (! (Person.inv2 3) :named _xkassert15))
(assert (! (Person.inv2 4) :named _xkassert16))
(assert (! (Person.inv2 5) :named _xkassert17))
(assert (! (Person.inv2 6) :named _xkassert18))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Person.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Person.child (Person!father this)) this)
)

(assert (! (Person.inv3 1) :named _xkassert19))
(assert (! (Person.inv3 2) :named _xkassert20))
(assert (! (Person.inv3 3) :named _xkassert21))
(assert (! (Person.inv3 4) :named _xkassert22))
(assert (! (Person.inv3 5) :named _xkassert23))
(assert (! (Person.inv3 6) :named _xkassert24))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Person const-1-Person))
        2 (lift-Person const-2-Person))
        3 (lift-Person const-3-Person))
        4 (lift-Person const-4-Person))
        5 (lift-Person const-5-Person))
        6 (lift-Person const-6-Person))
  )
)
